generated_by: @generated by `cargo run -p pcs-service --features conformance --example conformance_vectors -- emit`

cases.name: baseline
cases.note: A stream straight out of Dataset::write_ipc. Every codec must accept it and read these values back.

cases.name: trailing_bytes
cases.note: Bytes follow the zero-length terminator. The stream is complete at the terminator, so anything after it means the producer and consumer disagree about the payload.

cases.name: missing_terminator
cases.note: The zero-length terminator is absent, so the segment loop runs off the end.

cases.name: segment_longer_than_stream
cases.note: A segment's declared length runs past the end of the payload.

cases.name: empty_segment
cases.note: A segment carrying only an end-of-stream marker declares no component and must be reported as empty rather than as a wrong header type.

cases.name: bad_continuation_marker
cases.note: A message must open with 0xFFFFFFFF.

cases.name: message_longer_than_segment
cases.note: A message's metadata length runs past the end of its segment.

cases.name: extra_message_in_segment
cases.note: A segment carries exactly one Schema and one RecordBatch. A second RecordBatch means the reader would silently ignore data.

cases.name: bytes_after_segment_marker
cases.note: A segment is spent once its end-of-stream marker is read. Bytes after it mean the reader would silently drop data.

cases.name: first_message_not_schema
cases.note: A segment opens with its Schema message.

cases.name: dictionary_batch
cases.note: Dictionary encoding is outside this format. The refusal names it specifically, because a dictionary batch is a plausible thing for a writer to emit and a confusing thing to diagnose.

cases.name: unknown_header_type
cases.note: The second message must be a RecordBatch, and the refusal echoes the header type it actually found.

cases.name: negative_row_count
cases.note: A negative declared row count must be refused by the codec, not turned into a native allocation error deeper in.

cases.name: overflowing_row_count
cases.note: A declared row count no allocation could satisfy must be refused up front.

cases.name: nodes_field_count_mismatch
cases.note: The node count must equal the schema's field count. A short nodes vector means the buffer walk would read another field's buffers.

cases.name: buffer_overruns_body
cases.note: A buffer whose declared span leaves the message body must be refused before any column is read.

cases.name: negative_buffer_length
cases.note: A negative buffer length is not a usable span.

cases.name: missing_component_key
cases.note: A segment without the __pcs_component metadata key declares no component, so nothing can address it.

cases.name: compressed_batch
cases.note: A genuinely LZ4-compressed record batch, written by arrow-rs. The format carries no compression, so every codec refuses it rather than reading the compressed bytes as values.

cases.name: unknown_component
cases.note: Addressing a component the stream does not carry.

cases.name: unknown_field
cases.note: Addressing a field the component does not declare.

cases.name: type_mismatch
cases.note: Reading a Float64 column as Int64.

cases.name: row_out_of_range
cases.note: Writing past the last row.

cases.name: variable_width_write
cases.note: Writing a Utf8 column in place. Changing a string's length would move every later offset and the buffer lengths in the RecordBatch metadata.
